rules: An anomaly exists in World State before a scan detects it.
Rare phenomena use rarity/context rules and are not spawned because they are dramatic.
Temporal effects require explicit event/state transitions and may not silently erase campaign history.
Causal paradox/branch behavior must use an explicit rules profile rather than ad hoc narrative replacement.
Affected entities retain identity/history unless the temporal rule explicitly records a branch/replacement semantics.
AI may describe resolved anomaly effects but cannot author them.
